PR #13521 review points, all satisfied:
- **Per-member map is precedent-disciplined**: every IN/OUT verdict cites the #12003 audit-door rule it inherits, and the two deliberate divergences are the right ones — `organizationId` optional-not-nullable (mirror-the-implementation, not mirror-the-sibling: history's impl declares `organizationId?: string` and the door sends none), `limit` unbounded (declared bounds would refuse values the shipped verb accepts — the no-accept/reject-drift rule). `environmentId` stays out per #9741, dead spread recorded not removed. `ref.type` kept plain string per the #12038 1C anti-freezing reading.
- **Ablation is the real thing**: first single-file attempt correctly voided (generated manifest refused the build), redone five-path with the mutation proven on disk, red leg showing the exact TS2724/TS2339 the declaration exists to prevent, restore proven by hash-equality of all 5 blobs.
- Gates green at final head including the full spec+rest suites; the `check:doc-authoring` first-red on internal issue ids in describe() strings was a real catch, fixed in-flight. Changeset pair upgraded to #12003's actual class (spec minor + rest patch) — the dispatch's "patch" parenthetical was my under-read, dev's correction stands.
- Docs-drift three pages hand-read, none falsified (layer distinction on `getHistory` correctly drawn); releases pages untouched. Parking confirmed by post-relay read-back on both carriers — the "no labels" relay was again a labeler race, withdrawn.
- Handed-over finding filed as #13523 (ledger-row + `client.meta.getHistory` rebinding, #12038 class, sequenced after this PR lands).

Twin card #12004 (`saveMetaItem`) remains HELD in `pm:queue`, serialized behind this PR — next seat dispatches it after #13521 lands.
